claim_boundary: The pinned public EgoHumans benchmark contains 19,928 ego-RGB fencing frames, 29,192 person instances, 493,021 observed 2D keypoints, and 496,264 available 3D keypoints across 35 camera views and 13 annotated capture sequences. The three aria names are capture aliases, not evidence of three globally distinct athletes. Fourteen raw fencing sequence archives are listed, but sequence 007 has no ego-RGB rows in this benchmark JSON. The embedded COCO metadata labels images CC BY-NC-SA 2.0. Weapon, touch, score, and bout labels are absent. Five locally verified synchronized stills are different camera views of one scene, not five bouts or five independent samples; four official demo videos are links only and are not counted as downloaded training media.
grouping_rule: hold out complete 03_fencing subsequences; views and frames from one capture sequence must never cross train, validation, or test partitions
